title: Uriel
extract:
Release Date: December 10th, 2025
Burn away the  Orokin's ivory lies and aureate deceit. Here upon hellfire-seared brimstone, our darkest truth comes to light, lurid as Tauron azure. Hail thy heralds of catastrophe: Catenach the Shackled, Gulphagor the Ravager, and Vythelas the Runescribe, three fiendish devils beckoning to thine will. Sovereign of his demonic dominion, where charred flesh and scorched souls lay bare... condemn the damned to hellish torment as Uriel, the Heretic of Xata. Blaze as infernal incarnate, black as the deepest shadow, spiraling across the night sky until daybreak unveils a doomed tomorrow. Uriel and his hellspawn spiraled out of Hell in Update 41.0 (2025-12-10): The Old Peace.
The devil Warframe  Uriel commands demonic Summons to do his nefarious bidding. His Passive has three minions at his beck and call: Catenach links enemies with chains that causes damage inflicted to apply to all chained enemies, Gulphagor latches onto an enemy to stun them and killing them will yield a Health Orb and Energy Orb, and Vythelas desecrates enemy corpses to create runes that on pickup increases Fire Rate and  Heat damage.  Infernalis sets Uriel on fire and transforms his Dodges into a flying spiral drill.  Remedium heals Uriel, cleanses Status Effects, and heals or revives his minions.  Demonium hurls the souls of Uriel's minions to apply Damage Vulnerability.  Brimstone uses the fury of his minions to unleash a domain of Hell and create a massive  Heat field.

Acquisition
Uriel's main blueprint is acquired upon completion of The Old Peace quest. His component blueprints are obtained from Roathe's Oblivion on Infernium 21 of The Descendia.
Alternatively, Uriel's blueprints can be purchased from Roathe in La Cathėdrale, Sanctum Anatomica for  Maphica obtained in The Descendia. Each component blueprint costs 25 Maphica, and the main blueprint costs 75, totaling 150 Maphica for the full set.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.

Crafting
Uriel's materials are obtained from The Perita Rebellion.

Lore & History

Notes
Currently,  Vinquibus (Primary) and  Vinquibus (Melee) lacks a Signature Weapon bonus with Uriel.

Trivia
Uriel was the last Warframe concepted by Michael "Mynki" Brennan
Uriel is the 63rd unique Warframe to be released.
The name Uriel(אוּרִיאֵל ʾŪrīʾēl) is of Hebrew origin, meaning "God is my Light" and "Flame of God". Often associated with Uriel, the archangel of wisdom, enlightenment, and guidance.
Uriel's skeletal summon, Catenach, is likely named after a Catenary, the curve a hanging chain makes.
Uriel's winged summon, Gulphagor, is likely named after the Christian Demon Belphegor, known as the main demon of Sloth.
Uriel's alternate helmet appears to be named after the demon Asmodeus, known as the main demon of Lust.
Uriel is the first Warframe whose name begins with the letter "U", which is the final letter to be used by Warframes released since Vanilla (2012-10-25).
An unmodded Uriel at rank 30 will have 666 Health and 666 Shields, a reference to the Devil's number.
Uriel has a prehensile tail that can lengthen at will, shown in his agile unarmed idle and noble bow idle animations.
The spade-ended tail, and the appearance of their helmet forking into horns may tie into Uriel's devilish theme.
Uriel is one of the few warframes that have unique idle animations with the  Grimoire in both his noble and agile animation sets.
He is the first Warframe to have multiple summons as his Passive ability, and synchronized Emotes that the summons perform with Uriel.
When Uriel casts abilities, the Voidtongue phrase "RAZUL-TARAT KANUMMU" can be heard, making him one of the few Warframes who vocalise.
He is the twelfth Warframe after  Limbo,  Hildryn,  Wisp,  Titania Prime,  Protea,  Xaku,  Sevagoth,  Gyre,  Qorvex,  Dante, and  Jade with a unique dodge roll animation, where Uriel spirals forward or dashes sideways and backwards while upright.
He is the fifth Warframe after  Styanax,  Qorvex,  Koumei, and  Cyte-09 with unique walking sound effects, where Uriel's footsteps sound like hooves.
The  Murmur arm that appears in Uriel's agile rifle/shotgun and agile pistol animations does not change colours according to Uriel's assigned colours and will always be metallic teal, but the aura surrounding the arm is dependent on Uriel's Energy colour.
Uriel is currently the only Warframe whose portrait has him facing entirely sideways. All other Warframes either look to or angle slightly to their left-hand side.
